2000.why: It drew about two-thirds as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about engine.
2000.pln: about two-thirds as many complaints as the average car
td: Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Suspension
Drive over bumps: listen for clunks or rattles, and look for uneven tire wear.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Wheels
Look for bent or cracked wheels and listen for a hum or wobble at speed.
